note: The mechanical properties of the discovery-run record (#305 §7.1), one scenario per rule. `base` is a complete, well-formed sweep; each scenario shallow-merges its `overrides` onto it, so a scenario's diff is exactly the thing being tested. ⛔ Every figure is illustrative — these are not any listed company's prices and no row here is evidence about a market. What is asserted is that a given shape of run reaches a given status, because the four statuses are the whole point: a zero-candidate run that screened a roster and a zero-candidate run that read nothing are opposite facts that read identically in prose.

scenarios.name: a-complete-sweep-produces-candidates
scenarios.why: The control. Without it a scenario that fails for an unrelated reason reads as the rule working, and the cursor would appear pinned everywhere because it never moved anywhere.

scenarios.name: a-screen-that-ran-and-qualified-nobody
scenarios.why: The only run allowed to say that nothing qualified: a declared universe, every required lane open, no failed symbol. This is the fact the other three statuses exist to stop being claimed.

scenarios.name: an-undeclared-universe-is-not-a-screen-that-found-nothing
scenarios.why: The failure #305 asks for by name. Nothing was read, so nothing can be said to have failed the gate — and the run is still not blocked, because the holdings this desk owns still have to be watched on the sell side.

scenarios.name: a-budget-spent-on-holdings-is-discovery-not-run
scenarios.why: #305: 보유 검토가 탐색 예산을 소진했다면 신규 후보를 못 찾았다고 쓰지 말고 discovery_not_run으로 보고한다. The universe was declared and the lanes were open; the run simply never got there.

scenarios.name: both-required-lanes-dark-is-discovery-not-run
scenarios.why: The connection was down and the filing cache was never fetched. A run with no lane open has zero discovery capacity, and reporting that as a screen result is the #140 mechanism in a new package.

scenarios.name: the-token-is-carried-verbatim-or-the-proposal-is-refused
scenarios.why: The prose around it is written in the invocation's language, so a matcher looking for English words would pass every Korean run for the wrong reason. The token is the whole disclosure.

scenarios.name: and-a-run-that-carries-it-is-not-refused
scenarios.why: The other half of the same rule, so the refusal above is about the disclosure and not about the status.

uncertainty: discovery_not_run — 이번 실행은 유니버스를 선언하지 않았고 보유 검토만 수행했다

scenarios.name: a-failed-symbol-leaves-the-sweep-incomplete
scenarios.why: Part of the roster was not read. The cursor stays where it started, because a cursor that steps over an unread range deletes that range permanently — nothing later ever looks at it again.

scenarios.name: a-partial-filing-lane-leaves-the-sweep-incomplete
scenarios.why: OpenDART answered for some names and failed for others. Nothing failed in the price sweep, so the counts balance and only the lane says the run is unfinished.

scenarios.name: the-optional-lane-being-dark-does-not-stop-the-run
scenarios.why: Web is corroboration for this package and not an entrance. A run with price and filing open and no web reading still produces candidates — the inverse of catalyst-turnaround, where the web is required.

scenarios.name: the-shortlist-is-a-hard-cut-and-not-an-intention
scenarios.why: Five names passed and the configured shortlist is two. The other three are not rejections and the diagnostic names them, so the next run resumes on a list rather than re-deriving one.

scenarios.name: the-default-shortlist-is-three-when-no-config-arrived
scenarios.why: An invocation may carry no config block at all, and a package whose cut only exists in a setting has no cut.

scenarios.name: a-shortlist-may-not-be-ranked-by-depth-of-fall
scenarios.why: The deepest faller is the name most likely to have fallen for a reason, so this ordering ranks by the probability of the fall being correct. Stated outright, it is refused.

scenarios.name: and-it-may-not-be-ranked-by-depth-without-saying-so
scenarios.why: The same ordering with no rankBasis at all. Three names in strictly deepening order is a depth ranking whatever it is called, and two would have been a coincidence.

scenarios.name: an-unstated-rank-basis-is-unevaluated-and-not-passed
scenarios.why: Two names in an order nobody explained. The forbidden ordering cannot be ruled out, and «cannot be ruled out» is not «checked».

scenarios.name: finishing-none-of-what-was-carried-forward-is-reported
scenarios.why: #256's failure mode: five interesting names and no completed thesis. The floor is a setting and the report is not.

scenarios.name: the-counts-have-to-add-up
scenarios.why: A run that cannot say which part of the roster it read cannot say what it screened either, and the arithmetic is the only thing that catches it.

scenarios.name: a-lane-nobody-asked-about-is-unstated
scenarios.why: From evidence-gated's discoveryCapacity, unchanged: defaulting the unasked half to open is exactly how a run with no capacity reports a considered no-change.
